title: Analysis code for: Context-dependent H3K27me3 remodeling reveals a transitional chromatin state during adipogenic differentiation
description:
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript Context-dependent H3K27me3 remodeling reveals a transitional chromatin state during adipogenic differentiation.

The repository contains the CRR (contiguous repressive region) framework used to define broad H3K27me3 domains from binarised 200-bp genome-wide signal: bin stitching, the length-threshold sensitivity analysis, cross-stage merging, feature construction, QC and standardisation, MFA, graph-based clustering, and the corresponding sensitivity analyses. It also contains the plotting code for the main figures (Fig. 1-6) and the downstream tools for CRR-to-gene assignment, matched control regions and burden regression.

Input data are deposited at GEO under accession GSE346087 and are not redistributed in this repository; pipeline/scripts/01_geo_matrices_to_pipeline_input.sh converts the GEO deposit into the layout the pipeline expects.
